location_description: Huntsville is a city in Madison County, Limestone County, and Morgan County, Alabama, United States. It is the county seat of Madison County.  Located in the Appalachian region of northern Alabama, Huntsville is the most populous city in the state.Huntsville was founded within the Mississippi Territory in 1805 and became an incorporated town in 1811.
